_doc: Market gaps A2Z addresses with their honest scope status. Per docs/A2Z_LIVING_DOCS_PLAN.md Part 1+3, every claim has a source_file or source_url citation; every solution has a status marker (shipped/designed/roadmap).

gaps.pain_point: Banks struggle to translate strategic goals into individual actions. Quarterly board targets do not flow to teller-level KPIs.
gaps.current_state: Manual cascade in Excel; targets reset quarterly without continuous adjustment.
gaps.a2z_solution: Auto-cascade engine wiring MD → Director → Head → Regional → Branch Manager → individual roles via the system_stocks + KPI library.

gaps.pain_point: Staff receive performance feedback monthly — too late to change behaviour mid-cycle.
gaps.current_state: Monthly BSC reviews; no real-time signal to staff.
gaps.a2z_solution: BSC engine + KPI library (35 KPIs across 4 BSC pillars) updates from CBS aggregates; surface for daily review.
gaps.honest_scope: Real-time mobile alerts on KPI drift are roadmap (v9.x), not shipped. Polling-based dashboard is the current surface.

gaps.pain_point: Banks run 10-15 separate systems for credit, risk, HR, finance, customer ops; each with its own truth.
gaps.current_state: Manual data movement between FLEXCUBE, CRM, HRIS, GL.
gaps.a2z_solution: FLEXCUBE Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL) translates GROSS_OS/SEGMENT_DIST/STAGE_DIST to A2Z's normalised vocabulary inside utils/flexcube_aggregator.py. Single source of truth flows to all engines.
gaps.honest_scope: v8.0 shipped 5 live FLEXCUBE handlers. Temenos/T24 adapter is not built. Banks on T24 would need a sister adapter following the same ACL pattern.

gaps.pain_point: Traditional credit scoring excludes thin-file customers without formal credit history.
gaps.current_state: Manual underwriting takes 3-7 days; thin-file customers often declined.
gaps.a2z_solution: Alternative credit scoring engine using transaction velocity + utility-bill patterns + M-PESA history (where available).
gaps.solution_source: utils/alternative_credit_scoring.py (engine designed; not yet wired to UI)
gaps.honest_scope: 🟡 Engine designed in v6.x; not surfaced in UI. Production deployment requires CRB integration which is roadmap. External case studies (Zanifu 99.2% repayment) are cited industry research, not A2Z deployments.

gaps.pain_point: When ATM/mobile-app/USSD goes down, customers discover by trying — bank loses trust.
gaps.current_state: Reactive incident response; no proactive customer notification.
gaps.a2z_solution: L14 streaming closure: channels_reliability PRODUCER + smart_alerts CONSUMER + event_bus generates URGENT/HIGH/INFO tiered alerts with PUSH/SMS/IN_APP_BANNER delivery channels and alternative-channel guidance.
gaps.honest_scope: v8.4 closed L14 with file-backed event bus. Production multi-process deployment needs Kafka or Redis pub/sub (roadmap v9.x). Twilio/Firebase delivery integration is roadmap; v8.x ships the targeting metadata, not the delivery.

gaps.pain_point: Audit trails are scattered across systems; CBK reviews require manual reconstruction.
gaps.current_state: Audit-pack assembly takes weeks each cycle.
gaps.a2z_solution: 6-gate defense-in-depth audit perimeter (G104-G109). Single command verifies every cross-cutting invariant. Per-batch CHANGELOGs preserve narrative.
